{{recipesummary|category=Seafood recipes|servings=4|time=½ hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (1 [[Cookbook:Liter|liter]]) [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]] for [[Cookbook:Fry|frying]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Teriyaki|teriyaki]] glaze
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (225 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]
* 1 pound (20–30 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. / 450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) of [[Cookbook:Scallop|scallops]]

==Procedure==
# Heat oil in a deep-fryer or other pot to 350 °F (180 °C), making sure that the pot is large enough that the oil doesn't fill it more than halfway.
# Combine teriyaki glaze, soy sauce and sugar in a medium bowl. Set aside.
# Cut bacon strips in half lengthwise.
# Wrap each scallop with one of these half strips of bacon, and secure by skewering with a wooden [[Cookbook:Toothpick|toothpick]].
# Working in batches so as not to crowd the fryer, [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the scallops until golden brown, about 4 minutes.
# Remove from oil, drain briefly and toss in the soy-teriyaki sauce.
# Serve immediately.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Do not eat the toothpick!
